The first friend guesses 80.  
The second friend guesses 20 more than half of 80: half of 80 is 40, plus 20 gives 60.  
The third friend guesses 25% more than 80: 25% of 80 is 20, so 80 + 20 = 100.  
The three guesses are 80, 60, and 100. Their average is (80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80.

Answer: 80
